WITH sales_agg AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk, s.s_state,
           SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS qty_sum,
           COUNT(ss.ss_quantity) AS qty_cnt,
           SUM(ss.ss_list_price) AS price_sum,
           COUNT(ss.ss_list_price) AS price_cnt,
           SUM(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS coupon_sum,
           COUNT(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS coupon_cnt,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sales_sum,
           COUNT(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sales_cnt
    FROM (
        SELECT cd_demo_sk
        FROM customer_demographics
        WHERE cd_gender = 'M'
          AND cd_marital_status = 'W'
          AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
    ) AS cd
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN (
        SELECT d_date_sk
        FROM date_dim
        WHERE d_year = 1999
    ) AS d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN (
        SELECT s_store_sk, s_state
        FROM store
        WHERE s_state = 'TN'
    ) AS s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, s.s_state
)
SELECT i.i_item_id, sa.s_state, grouping(sa.s_state) AS g_state,
       CAST(SUM(sa.qty_sum) AS numeric) / SUM(sa.qty_cnt) AS agg1,
       CAST(SUM(sa.price_sum) AS numeric) / SUM(sa.price_cnt) AS agg2,
       CAST(SUM(sa.coupon_sum) AS numeric) / SUM(sa.coupon_cnt) AS agg3,
       CAST(SUM(sa.sales_sum) AS numeric) / SUM(sa.sales_cnt) AS agg4
FROM sales_agg sa
JOIN item i ON sa.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i.i_item_id, sa.s_state)
ORDER BY i_item_id, s_state
LIMIT 100
